items.title: Hal Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: Sidney Bechet is a God in France still.

ctx.x: Right. We had a lot of our jazz musicians booking over there.

Sure. And then they stayed there forever. I mean the black musicians who went there were treated like human beings and didn’t have to look over their shoulder every time, and they had long and productive lives. Sidney Bechet is a God in France still. And I think that’s too bad that in his own country he couldn’t be treated that way.
Well I’m hoping you don’t have to move over there.
